player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Chopsticks. On your turn, choose one of:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=your hand (0 or 1), O=opponent hand (0 or 1).
    - Opponent's hand count increases by your hand; if >=5, it becomes 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  to redistribute your total fingers into L and R (L+R = your total).
Reply with exactly one of those commands.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: ናይ ተጻባኢ ኢድ {opp_idx} ድሮ ሞይቱ እዩ።
invalid_move.split_no_change: ስፕሊት ነቲ ናይ ኢድ ኣወሃህባኻ ክቕይሮ ኣለዎ።
invalid_move.invalid_command: Invalid move. Use “[attack M O]” or “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} attacks P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: it goes from {opp_val} to {new_val}.

outcome.draw: እቲ ናይ ምምላስ ገደብ በጺሑ ኣሎ።
